selection_policy: V4 source, profile, thresholds, ten base policies, and validation evidence are frozen before any V4 test evaluation
test_access_policy: V4 test was accessed once after source, profile, thresholds, base policy hashes, and validation evidence were frozen
limitations: Historical AIS traffic is replayed in an offline counterfactual simulator.
The COLREG signal is a declared engineering proxy, not certification.
No live VTS/TOS, official in-force ENC, sensor freshness, HIL, sea trial, or authority approval is present.
Rare escape-plan searches may exceed the P95 budget even when aggregate P95 passes; latency tails remain review evidence.
